canonical_goal.outcome_variable: o_rel = (G_A, Z_A, m_gap, gamma_gap, T_c, f_pi, p_dec, Delta_IR) ∈ O_P
canonical_goal.target_object: A proposition that the Landau-gauge gluon propagator G_A(p) = 1/(Z_A(p) p^2) contains a renormalisation-group-invariant gluon mass gap m_gap, defined by omega_gap = (1 + i gamma_gap) m_gap and omega_gap = argmin_{omega_s != 0}{Re omega_s : Z_A(-omega_s^2) = 0}, and that this scale has physical meaning because the SU(3) Yang-Mills confinement-deconfinement transition temperature T_c is linearly proportional to m_gap and because both T_c and the 2+1 flavour QCD pion decay constant f_pi are insensitive to infrared deformations of G_A(p) whose deformation scale remains below the decoupling scale p_dec approximately equal to p_in^-.
feasibility_constraints: The Euclidean gluon two-point function is evaluated in Landau gauge and has the transverse form <A_mu^a(p) A_nu^b(-p)> = G_A(p) delta_ab Pi_perp_mu_nu(p), where Pi_perp_mu_nu(p) = delta_mu_nu - p_mu p_nu/p^2 and G_A(p) = 1/(Z_A(p) p^2).

The gluon mass gap is the real part m_gap of the first non-zero complex singularity encoded by Z_A(-omega_s^2) = 0, with omega_gap = (1 + i gamma_gap) m_gap and omega_gap = argmin_{omega_s != 0}{Re omega_s : Z_A(-omega_s^2) = 0}.

The renormalisation-group invariance of m_gap is fixed by the chain of statements (mu d/dmu + 2 gamma_A) G_A(p) = 0, G_A(p) = 1/(Z_A(p) p^2), hence (mu d/dmu - 2 gamma_A) Z_A(p) = 0, and therefore mu d Z_A(omega_s)/dmu = 0 at every zero omega_s of Z_A; the zero condition Z_A(-omega_s^2) = 0 and Re omega_gap = m_gap are invariant under changes of the renormalisation scale mu.

For T_c, the admissible observable is SU(3) Yang-Mills T_c computed from the background temporal gauge-field effective potential V_eff(phi_3, phi_8) = sum_{i in {A,c}} sum_n c_i V_i,mode(nu_n), with gluon multiplicity c_A = 2, ghost multiplicity c_c = -1, vacuum ghost and gluon propagators as inputs, omitted two-loop terms, and T_c defined as the temperature at which the centre-symmetric and centre-broken minima of V_eff exchange dominance.

For f_pi, the admissible observable is the 2+1 flavour QCD pion decay constant computed from the quark propagator G_qqbar(p) = 1/(Z_q(p)(i slash(p) + M_q(p))) obtained from the Landau-gauge quark gap equation using Gamma_mu^perp(k+p,-p) = Pi_perp_mu_nu(k) gamma_nu g_s lambda_1(k+p,-p), alpha_s = g_s^2/(4 pi) = 0.54 at mu = 4.3 GeV fixed so that M_q(0) = 350 MeV, and f_pi^2 = 4 N_c integral d^4p/(2 pi)^4 [Zbar_2/Z_q(p)] [M_q(p)/(p^2 + M_q(p)^2)^2] [M_q(p) - (p^2/2) partial_{p^2} M_q(p)] with Zbar_2 = Z_q(0).

The infrared deformation family is Delta_IR = {G_A^{sigma,nu} : sigma ∈ {+1,-1}, nu ∈ [0.1,0.5] GeV}, where G_A^{sigma,nu}(p) = G_A,fit(p) + sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3]; the parameter 3.3 GeV^{-2} fixes the deformation at p = 0, the exponent 3 fixes the falloff in p/nu, and nu fixes the momentum scale below which the deformation is concentrated.

success_set.definition: Sigma_P = { o_rel : m_gap is fixed by omega_gap = (1 + i gamma_gap) m_gap and omega_gap = argmin_{omega_s != 0}{Re omega_s : Z_A(-omega_s^2) = 0}; in Yang-Mills theory the fitted zero condition gives m_gap = 686 MeV and the background-field effective-potential computation gives T_c = 275 MeV, so the baseline proportionality coefficient is c_conf = T_c/m_gap = 275/686 = 0.401; under rescalings in which the dimensionless fit shape is held fixed and the single mass scale m_gap is varied, T_c = c_conf m_gap; for every deformation G_A^{sigma,nu}(p) = G_A,fit(p) + sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3] with nu < p_in^-, the recomputed ratios T_c^{sigma,nu}/T_c and f_pi^{sigma,nu}/f_pi remain practically equal to 1, and in the 2+1 flavour case |f_pi^{sigma,nu}/f_pi - 1| < 0.01 for deformations below p_in^- = 390 MeV; for deformations with nu at or above p_in^-, the recomputed observables change visibly. }

robustness_scope.ambient_space: Euclidean scalar gluon propagator functions G_A : [0,infinity) -> R transformed by G_A(p) -> G_A^{sigma,nu}(p) = G_A,fit(p) + sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3], with sigma ∈ {+1,-1} and nu ∈ [0.1,0.5] GeV.

claimed_subfamily.definition: {(sigma, nu) : sigma ∈ {+1,-1}, 0.1 GeV <= nu < p_in^-}, where p_in^- is the lower-momentum solution of partial_p^2 Z_A^{-1}(p)=0 for the corresponding fitted gluon dressing; the operational values are p_in^- = 370 MeV for Yang-Mills theory and p_in^- = 390 MeV for 2+1 flavour QCD.

robustness_scope.criterion: For every deformation G_A^{sigma,nu}(p) = G_A,fit(p) + sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3] with 0.1 GeV <= nu < p_in^-, recompute SU(3) Yang-Mills T_c from the exchange of centre-symmetric and centre-broken minima of V_eff(phi_3,phi_8), recompute Z_q^{sigma,nu}(p) and M_q^{sigma,nu}(p) from the quark gap equation, and recompute f_pi^{sigma,nu} from f_pi^2 = 4 N_c integral d^4p/(2 pi)^4 [Zbar_2/Z_q(p)] [M_q(p)/(p^2 + M_q(p)^2)^2] [M_q(p) - (p^2/2) partial_{p^2} M_q(p)]; the claimed robustness criterion is T_c^{sigma,nu}/T_c = 1 within the plotted numerical resolution and |f_pi^{sigma,nu}/f_pi - 1| < 0.01 for the 2+1 flavour deformations below 390 MeV.

canonical_goal.outcome_variable: o_reg = (Z_A^{-1}, p_in^+, p_peak, p_in^-, p_dec, R_uv, R_sc, R_ir) ∈ O_P
canonical_goal.target_object: A proposition that the Landau-gauge gluon dressing Z_A^{-1}(p) admits an operational three-region partition of Euclidean momenta: an ultraviolet proxy region R_uv = {p : p > p_in^+}, an intermediate strongly correlated proxy region R_sc = {p : p_in^- <= p <= p_in^+}, and a deep-infrared proxy region R_ir = {p : 0 <= p < p_in^-}; p_in^+ and p_in^- are the two inflection points of Z_A^{-1}(p), p_peak is the maximum of Z_A^{-1}(p), p_in^- approximates p_dec, and p_peak proxies the gluon mass-gap scale.
feasibility_constraints: The fitted or measured gluon dressing Z_A^{-1}(p) is twice differentiable on positive Euclidean momenta and has two positive solutions of partial_p^2 Z_A^{-1}(p)=0 and one positive maximizer of Z_A^{-1}(p).
The ultraviolet inflection point p_in^+ is the larger positive solution of partial_p^2 Z_A^{-1}(p)=0.
The infrared inflection point p_in^- is the smaller positive solution of partial_p^2 Z_A^{-1}(p)=0.
The peak position p_peak is defined by Z_A^{-1}(p_peak)=max_{p>=0} Z_A^{-1}(p), equivalently partial_p Z_A(p)|_{p=p_peak}=0 when the maximum is an interior point.

The decoupling scale p_dec is estimated from observables as the largest deformation scale below which G_A^{sigma,nu}(p) = G_A,fit(p) + sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3] leaves T_c and f_pi unchanged within the reported numerical resolution; this operational p_dec is identified with p_in^-.

success_set.definition: Sigma_P = { o_reg : for N_f=0 Yang-Mills theory, the derivative definitions give p_in^+ = 1294 MeV, p_peak = 892 MeV, and p_in^- = 370 MeV; for N_f=2+1 flavour QCD, the same derivative definitions give p_in^+ = 1638 MeV, p_peak = 1112 MeV, and p_in^- = 391 MeV; in both cases p_in^- < p_peak < p_in^+; the operational proxy regions are R_ir = {p : 0 <= p < p_in^-}, R_sc = {p : p_in^- <= p <= p_in^+}, and R_uv = {p : p > p_in^+}; p_dec ≈ p_in^- is supported by the deformation test in which T_c and f_pi remain invariant below p_in^- and change above p_in^-; p_peak is used as a proxy for the gluon mass-gap scale. }

canonical_goal.outcome_variable: o_fit = (Z_A,fit, m_gap, gamma_gap, z_sat, z_peak, z_gh, z_uv, c_uv, c_+, c_-) ∈ O_P
canonical_goal.target_object: A parameterised end-state consisting of a decoupling-type Landau-gauge gluon inverse dressing Z_A,fit(p) whose only explicit kinematic mass scale is m_gap and whose non-mass parameters are assigned to ultraviolet, strongly correlated, deep-infrared, or interface properties of the fitted gluon dressing.
feasibility_constraints: The fitted inverse dressing has the form Z_A,fit(p) = Z_A,ir(x) + Z_A,uv(x), where x = p^2/m_gap^2.
The infrared component is Z_A,ir(x) = [z_sat/x - z_peak - z_gh log(1 + 1/(c_- x))]/(1 + c_+ x)^2.
The ultraviolet component is Z_A,uv(x) = z_uv [1 + c_uv log(1 + c_+ x)]^gamma.
The anomalous-dimension exponent is gamma = (13 - (4/3) N_f)/(22 - (4/3) N_f).
The fit satisfies the renormalisation condition Z_A,fit(mu^2/m_gap^2) = 1 with mu = 4.3 GeV.

The gluon mass gap m_gap and dimensionless width gamma_gap are determined by solving Z_A,fit(-omega_s^2) = 0 with omega_s = (1 + i gamma_gap) m_gap and selecting the non-zero solution with minimal positive Re omega_s.

The ultraviolet parameters z_uv and c_uv control the large-momentum logarithmic behaviour of Z_A,fit; z_peak fixes the peak region associated with the strongly correlated Schwinger-mechanism momentum range; z_sat and z_gh fix the p -> 0 saturation and the logarithmic ghost-loop contribution in the deep infrared; and c_+ and c_- control the interfaces among the ultraviolet, strongly correlated, and deep-infrared regions.

success_set.definition: Sigma_P = { o_fit : Z_A,fit(p)=Z_A,ir(p^2/m_gap^2)+Z_A,uv(p^2/m_gap^2) with Z_A,ir, Z_A,uv, and gamma defined in the feasibility constraints; for N_f=0, the fitted parameter tuple is m_gap=686 MeV, gamma_gap=0.585, z_sat=0.245, z_peak=0.670, z_gh=0.036, z_uv=0.853, c_uv=0.326, c_+=0.074, c_-=3.71; for N_f=2+1, the fitted parameter tuple is m_gap=818 MeV, gamma_gap=0.399, z_sat=0.279, z_peak=0.175, z_gh=0.050, z_uv=0.540, c_uv=1.47, c_+=0.162, c_-=3.70; m_gap in each tuple is obtained by solving Z_A,fit(-omega_s^2)=0 with omega_s=(1+i gamma_gap)m_gap after imposing the stated form and renormalisation condition. }

stated_goal.formalisation: The stated goal is the joint proposition G1 ∧ G2 ∧ G3: define m_gap by omega_gap = (1+i gamma_gap)m_gap and omega_gap = argmin_{omega_s != 0}{Re omega_s : Z_A(-omega_s^2)=0}; show that T_c and f_pi give this scale physical meaning through T_c = (275/686) m_gap for the Yang-Mills baseline shape and through infrared deformation tests that leave T_c and f_pi unchanged below p_dec≈p_in^-; characterise the operational momentum partition R_ir={p:0<=p<p_in^-}, R_sc={p:p_in^-<=p<=p_in^+}, and R_uv={p:p>p_in^+}; and construct Z_A,fit(p)=Z_A,ir(p^2/m_gap^2)+Z_A,uv(p^2/m_gap^2) with non-mass parameters assigned to physical roles in those regions.

operational_goal.formalisation: The operational goal is implemented by locating p_in^+ and p_in^- from the two positive solutions of partial_p^2 Z_A^{-1}(p)=0 and p_peak from Z_A^{-1}(p_peak)=max_{p>=0} Z_A^{-1}(p); deforming the fitted propagator by G_A^{sigma,nu}(p)=G_A,fit(p)+sigma 3.3 GeV^{-2} exp[-(p/nu)^3] with sigma ∈ {+1,-1} and nu ∈ [0.1,0.5] GeV; recomputing SU(3) Yang-Mills T_c from the centre-structure of V_eff(phi_3,phi_8); recomputing f_pi from the quark gap equation and the Pagels-Stokar integral; defining m_gap through omega_gap=(1+i gamma_gap)m_gap and Z_A(-omega_gap^2)=0 with minimal non-zero Re omega_gap; and fitting Z_A,fit(p)=Z_A,ir(p^2/m_gap^2)+Z_A,uv(p^2/m_gap^2) with the two reported parameter tuples.
